description: Different model profiles should preserve bounded Kotest support, module ownership, and asserted evidence.

lockedFields.reason: A conventional Gradle module with a runnable Kotest spec should retain high confidence.
Kotest execution stays anchored to the checked-in Gradle wrapper and JUnit Platform task.
The supported FunSpec fixture should not acquire an unsupported-boundary blocker.
The untested formatter should remain a new-test recommendation.
The parser's existing Kotest evidence should produce an extension recommendation.
Module-owned untested logic should remain the leading add-test item.
The parser should remain linked to its runnable Kotest spec.
The plan must preserve exact Kotest evidence provenance.
A result consumed by shouldBe should remain asserted evidence.
